title: Sundar Than Na
desc: When a person moves forward in life, what is the key thing that a person must remember? Javed Akhar talks about this important life lesson in this episode.

title: Aawat Hi Harsh
desc: Is it wrong to be ambitious and have a desire to do or buy things that one likes? Javed Akhtar gives a beautiful answer to this ever-popping question in human minds.

title: Dosti
desc: Javed Akhtar sometimes says we are so lost in our world that we are clueless about the struggles.

title: Raqeeb
desc: Javed Akhtar talks about Raqeeb whom he refers to as a villain in a love story.

title: Ibtedaaye Ishq
desc: Javed Akhtar explains the term *Ibtedaaye Ishq* which means beginning of love.

title: Similarities
desc: Javed Akhtar notes poets' diverse interpretations of love and friendship.

title: Bacche
desc: Bacche

title: Charagh
desc: Javed Akhtar explains the term Charagh which means a lamp. He says every poet has used the term lamp in different contexts such as lamp as light in darkness, lamp as a guide, lamp as a son, etc.

title: Ghar
desc: Javed Akhtar explains the difference between the terms house & home, he says house is just a structure where one can find shelter while home is where people reside together in love & harmony.

title: Kahaaniyat
desc: Kahaaniyat

title: Sadhu
desc: Javed Akhtar talks about sadhu being used as a metaphor to describe a positive human. He says a person must be simple & strong internally & externally just like a sadhu to deal with various challenges in life.

title: Sarsuti Ke Bhandar
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets the doha "Sarsuti Ke Bhandar" with today's situations in corporate life and says knowledge is a wealth that increases by sharing and it mutually adds to the teacher and the student.

title: Burey Lagat
desc: During a person's journey to success he usually tends to lose the people who are real and is flooded with only admirers. Javed Akhtar explains the reason behind this and how to overcome it.
